title: auth.tenant.access_changed v1
description: The tenant entered or left EVERY module's roster without any tenant_modules row changing: it was blocked, unblocked, soft-deleted, hard-deleted, or its activo flag changed through update_tenant (the roster excludes inactive and blocked tenants). A consumer re-checks the tenant for every module it runs. Emitted by svc-auth through the transactional outbox (app/services/module_lifecycle_events.py) in the SAME commit as the write that caused it, and published by EventOutboxRelayWorker as {"message": json.dumps(payload)} on stream alebrije:events:auth (at least once). ADR-115 Addendum D6: it is a NUDGE, not the state — a consumer re-reads the roster GET /api/v1/internal/modules/{module_id}/tenants (the single source) before acting, so a late, repeated or reordered event converges to the truth, and keeps its own periodic reconciler for an event that never arrives. FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape), with schema_version, like auth.dsr.erasure_approved.

event_id.description: UUID4 of this event, equal to auth.event_outbox.event_id (UNIQUE there). Consumer-side dedup key.

event_type.description: Canonical event type. Consumers route on this exact value.

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose module state changed (shared.tenants.id). The consumer re-checks THIS tenant against the roster.

activo.description: shared.tenants.activo after the change (false after a soft or hard delete).
